step1_analysis.circuit_type: PMOS Bias and Current Mirror Sub-circuit
step1_analysis.description: A sub-circuit consisting of a PMOS current mirror (XM1, XM3) and two parallel PMOS current sources (XM2, XM4) driving a common output node. It likely serves as an active load or bias network in the curvature-compensated bandgap reference or its operational amplifier.

paper_reference.title: Curvature-Compensated BiCMOS Bandgap with 1-V Supply Voltage

Power Consumption.description: Total power drawn from the supply voltage.

sky130_expected.calculation: Assuming 10uA bias currents applied to N0 and N2, and VLABEL_NET_0=0.9V. XM2 Vsg=0.9V -> Id2 = 0.5 * 50u * 10 * (0.9-0.42)^2 = 57.6uA. XM4 Vsg=0.62V -> Id4 = 10uA. Total current = 10u + 10u + 57.6u + 10u = 87.6uA. Power = 1.8V * 87.6uA = 157.7uW.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Adjusted for SKY130 1.8V supply and assumed 10uA bias currents for testing the sub-circuit.

Output Current.description: Total current sourced to the output node N1.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Based on square-law model for SKY130 PMOS with Vsg=0.9V and Vsg=0.62V.

Bias Voltage N0.description: Diode-connected voltage at N0 for a 10uA input current.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Standard diode-connected PMOS voltage drop calculation.

step3_testbench.description: Measures DC operating point and output current variation with input bias voltage.
step3_testbench.spice:
* PMOS Bias Sub-circuit Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u

XM1 N0 N0 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM2 N1 LABEL_NET_0 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM3 N2 N0 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM4 N1 N2 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}

* Voltage and Current Sources
VVDD VDD 0 1.8
VLABEL_NET_0 LABEL_NET_0 0 0.9
I0 N0 0 10u
I2 N2 0 10u
V1 N1 0 0.9

.control
* DC Operating Point
op
print v(N0) v(N2) v(N1)
let power = -i(VVDD) * 1.8
print power

* DC Sweep to measure output current vs bias voltage
dc VLABEL_NET_0 0 1.8 0.01
meas dc i_out_0_9 find i(V1) at=0.9
meas dc i_vdd_0_9 find i(VVDD) at=0.9
let pwr_dc = -i_vdd_0_9 * 1.8
print pwr_dc

quit
.endc
